001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Control-IQ's state for one 5-minute algorithm cycle: its glucose estimate and prediction,
009 * net IOB, TDI estimate, correction factor, target, the programmed basal it starts from, and
010 * what it commands (the hypoglycemia brake, the cycle's insulin and the increase above profile).
011 * Written every ~300 s on t:slim X2 and Mobi, including with Control-IQ off and with no CGM,
012 * directly before opcode 327 in the same second and before the next {@link BasalDeliveryHistoryLog}
013 * (about 30 s later on Mobi, about 90 s on the X2).
014 *
015 * <p>Evidence, from about 11,000 records in 10 pump datasets: {@link #getProgrammedBasalRate()} matches
016 * the next BasalDelivery's programmed rate in 99.5%; {@link #getHypoBrake()} is the stated function
017 * of {@link #getPredictedGlucoseX100()} in 96-100% per dataset; with Control-IQ on,
018 * {@link #getCycleInsulinMilliunits()} is the next BasalDelivery's algorithm rate over 12 (plus any
019 * automatic correction bolus) in 98-99%. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.
020 *
021 * <p>These are pump-internal Control-IQ values. Do not use them for dosing or as the IOB.
022 *
023 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 227 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
024 * app's history log list. {@link #getSleepRamp()} is exposed raw because its meaning is unknown.
025 */
026
027/**
028 * History log record Control-IQ Cycle, opCode 227, size 26.
029 *
030 * <br>
031 *
032 * Control-IQ's state for one 5-minute algorithm cycle: its glucose estimate and prediction,
033 * net IOB, TDI estimate, correction factor, target, the programmed basal it starts from, and
034 * what it commands (the hypoglycemia brake, the cycle's insulin and the increase above profile).
035 * Written every ~300 s on t:slim X2 and Mobi, including with Control-IQ off and with no CGM,
036 * directly before opcode 327 in the same second and before the next {@link BasalDeliveryHistoryLog}
037 * (about 30 s later on Mobi, about 90 s on the X2).
038 *
039 * <p>Evidence, from about 11,000 records in 10 pump datasets: {@link #getProgrammedBasalRate()} matches
040 * the next BasalDelivery's programmed rate in 99.5%; {@link #getHypoBrake()} is the stated function
041 * of {@link #getPredictedGlucoseX100()} in 96-100% per dataset; with Control-IQ on,
042 * {@link #getCycleInsulinMilliunits()} is the next BasalDelivery's algorithm rate over 12 (plus any
043 * automatic correction bolus) in 98-99%. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.
044 *
045 * <p>These are pump-internal Control-IQ values. Do not use them for dosing or as the IOB.
046 *
047 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 227 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
048 * app's history log list. {@link #getSleepRamp()} is exposed raw because its meaning is unknown.
049 *
050 * 
051 * <table border='1'>
052 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
053 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>227</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
054 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Control-IQ Cycle"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
055 * </table>
056 */@HistoryLogProps(
057    opCode = 227,
058    displayName = "Control-IQ Cycle"
059)
060public class ControlIQCycleHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
061
062    private int basalIncreaseMilliunits;
063    private int cycleInsulinMilliunits;
064    private int predictedGlucoseX100;
065    private int programmedBasalRate;
066    private int netIobMilliunits;
067    private int glucoseEstimate;
068    private int correctionFactor;
069    private int tdiEstimate;
070    private int hypoBrake;
071    private int sleepRamp;
072    private int upperTarget;
073
074    public ControlIQCycleHistoryLog() {}
075    public ControlIQCycleHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int basalIncreaseMilliunits, int cycleInsulinMilliunits, int predictedGlucoseX100, int programmedBasalRate, int netIobMilliunits, int glucoseEstimate, int correctionFactor, int tdiEstimate, int hypoBrake, int sleepRamp, int upperTarget) {
076        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
077        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, basalIncreaseMilliunits, cycleInsulinMilliunits, predictedGlucoseX100, programmedBasalRate, netIobMilliunits, glucoseEstimate, correctionFactor, tdiEstimate, hypoBrake, sleepRamp, upperTarget);
078        this.basalIncreaseMilliunits = basalIncreaseMilliunits;
079        this.cycleInsulinMilliunits = cycleInsulinMilliunits;
080        this.predictedGlucoseX100 = predictedGlucoseX100;
081        this.programmedBasalRate = programmedBasalRate;
082        this.netIobMilliunits = netIobMilliunits;
083        this.glucoseEstimate = glucoseEstimate;
084        this.correctionFactor = correctionFactor;
085        this.tdiEstimate = tdiEstimate;
086        this.hypoBrake = hypoBrake;
087        this.sleepRamp = sleepRamp;
088        this.upperTarget = upperTarget;
089    }
090
091    public int typeId() {
092        return 227;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * <table border="1">
097     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQCycleHistoryLog:</caption>
098     * <tr><td><code>basalIncreaseMilliunits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
099     * <tr><td><code>cycleInsulinMilliunits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
100     * <tr><td><code>predictedGlucoseX100</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
101     * <tr><td><code>programmedBasalRate</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
102     * <tr><td><code>netIobMilliunits</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
103     * <tr><td><code>glucoseEstimate</code></td><td><code>raw[20] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td><code>correctionFactor</code></td><td><code>raw[21] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
105     * <tr><td><code>tdiEstimate</code></td><td><code>raw[22] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
106     * <tr><td><code>hypoBrake</code></td><td><code>raw[23] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td><code>sleepRamp</code></td><td><code>raw[24] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
108     * <tr><td><code>upperTarget</code></td><td><code>raw[25] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
109     * </table>
110     */
111    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
112        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
113        this.cargo = raw;
114        parseBase(raw);
115        this.basalIncreaseMilliunits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
116        this.cycleInsulinMilliunits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
117        this.predictedGlucoseX100 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
118        this.programmedBasalRate = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
119        this.netIobMilliunits = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
120        this.glucoseEstimate = raw[20] & 0xFF;
121        this.correctionFactor = raw[21] & 0xFF;
122        this.tdiEstimate = raw[22] & 0xFF;
123        this.hypoBrake = raw[23] & 0xFF;
124        this.sleepRamp = raw[24] & 0xFF;
125        this.upperTarget = raw[25] & 0xFF;
126    }
127
128    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int basalIncreaseMilliunits, int cycleInsulinMilliunits, int predictedGlucoseX100, int programmedBasalRate, int netIobMilliunits, int glucoseEstimate, int correctionFactor, int tdiEstimate, int hypoBrake, int sleepRamp, int upperTarget) {
129        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
130            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(227, 0),
131            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
132            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
133            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(basalIncreaseMilliunits),
134            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(cycleInsulinMilliunits),
135            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(predictedGlucoseX100),
136            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(programmedBasalRate),
137            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(netIobMilliunits),
138            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(glucoseEstimate),
139            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(correctionFactor),
140            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(tdiEstimate),
141            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(hypoBrake),
142            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(sleepRamp),
143            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(upperTarget)));
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * floor(max(0, algorithmRate - profileBasalRate) / 12) for the next
148     * {@link BasalDeliveryHistoryLog}. Nonzero only when Control-IQ raises basal above the profile
149     * (never with Control-IQ off).
150     *
151     * @return the cycle's basal increase above the profile rate, in milliunits per 5 minutes
152     */
153    public int getBasalIncreaseMilliunits() {
154        return basalIncreaseMilliunits;
155    }
156
157    /**
158     * With Control-IQ on: floor(algorithmRate / 12) for the next {@link BasalDeliveryHistoryLog},
159     * plus the requested amount of a Control-IQ automatic correction bolus started in this cycle.
160     * With Control-IQ off: close to floor(programmedBasalRate / 12 * hypoBrakeFraction) (81-99% of
161     * records on three Mobis), which the pump then does not deliver.
162     *
163     * @return the insulin the algorithm computes for this cycle, in milliunits
164     */
165    public int getCycleInsulinMilliunits() {
166        return cycleInsulinMilliunits;
167    }
168
169    /**
170     * Predicted glucose x100, floored at 2000. Roughly the glucose estimate plus 20 minutes of the
171     * recent CGM trend, minus an insulin effect; the exact prediction horizon is not confirmed.
172     *
173     * @return the predicted glucose in mg/dL x 100
174     */
175    public int getPredictedGlucoseX100() {
176        return predictedGlucoseX100;
177    }
178
179    /**
180     * @return {@link #getPredictedGlucoseX100()} in mg/dL
181     */
182    public double getPredictedGlucoseMgdl() {
183        return predictedGlucoseX100 / 100.0;
184    }
185
186    /**
187     * The active temp rate if one is running, else the profile rate; the profile rate while
188     * suspended. Capped at 3000. On Control-IQ v7.6 Mobi firmware this is the profile rate even
189     * during a temp rate.
190     *
191     * @return the programmed basal rate, in milliunits/hr
192     */
193    public int getProgrammedBasalRate() {
194        return programmedBasalRate;
195    }
196
197    /**
198     * Not the IOB the pump displays. Fits boluses plus (delivered - programmed) basal through a
199     * two-compartment curve (1 + t/tau) * e^(-t/tau) with tau = 34 minutes, floored at 0
200     * (r 0.97-0.9998 in 8 datasets).
201     *
202     * @return the algorithm's net insulin on board, in milliunits
203     */
204    public int getNetIobMilliunits() {
205        return netIobMilliunits;
206    }
207
208    /**
209     * Tracks the latest CGM reading (r 0.997-0.998, usually 1 mg/dL below it) and saturates at 255.
210     * With no CGM paired to the pump it stays near a fixed value.
211     *
212     * @return the algorithm's current glucose estimate, in mg/dL
213     */
214    public int getGlucoseEstimate() {
215        return glucoseEstimate;
216    }
217
218    /**
219     * min(floor(1800 / TDI estimate), profile correction factor) in 2024-2026 data; 1500 instead of
220     * 1800 in the 2022 records and part of 2023.
221     *
222     * @return the correction factor the algorithm uses, in mg/dL per unit
223     */
224    public int getCorrectionFactor() {
225        return correctionFactor;
226    }
227
228    /**
229     * The integer part of the estimate in the AATdiEstChange record (opcode 332) that the Mobi writes
230     * hourly in the same second, just before this record.
231     *
232     * @return the total daily insulin estimate, in whole units per day
233     */
234    public int getTdiEstimate() {
235        return tdiEstimate;
236    }
237
238    /**
239     * floor(200 / (1 + 2.5 * r)) for predicted glucose G = {@link #getPredictedGlucoseMgdl()} &gt;= 70,
240     * and 0 below 70, where r = 10 * f^2 when f = 1.509 * (ln(G)^1.084 - 5.381) is negative and 0
241     * otherwise (Kovatchev's low-BG risk, zero at 112.5 mg/dL). 200 means no attenuation.
242     *
243     * @return the hypoglycemia brake factor, 0-200
244     */
245    public int getHypoBrake() {
246        return hypoBrake;
247    }
248
249    /**
250     * @return {@link #getHypoBrake()} as a fraction, 0.0 (full brake) to 1.0 (none)
251     */
252    public double getHypoBrakeFraction() {
253        return hypoBrake / 200.0;
254    }
255
256    /**
257     * 0 outside sleep. In sleep mode it rises by 3 or 4 per cycle (40 per hour) to 200 over five
258     * hours; after sleep ends it falls by 4-5 per cycle. Meaning unknown.
259     *
260     * @return raw uint8 at offset 24
261     */
262    public int getSleepRamp() {
263        return sleepRamp;
264    }
265
266    /**
267     * 160 in normal and exercise mode and 120 in sleep mode, moving between them over about
268     * 40-90 minutes after a mode change.
269     *
270     * @return the upper bound of the Control-IQ target range, in mg/dL
271     */
272    public int getUpperTarget() {
273        return upperTarget;
274    }
275}
